mapper.select: SELECT CD.district_code, CD.district_name, CD.initial_capital, CD.x_coordinate, CD.y_coordinate, CD.AREA, DB.store_count FROM COMMERCIAL_DISTRICT CD LEFT OUTER JOIN DISTRICT_BUSINESS DB ON CD.district_code = DB.district_code WHERE CD.initial_capital = #{initial_capital} AND DB.detail_category_name = #{detail_category_name}
